topMissing.labelFr: Résistance à la Traction des Fibres

verificationQueue.testStandard: ASTM C311/C311M (strength activity index); use EN 450-1 for fly ash or EN 13263-1 for silica fume where applicable
verificationQueue.evidence: Supplier certificate or laboratory report identifying the SCM type, test age, reference cement/mortar and measured activity index.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric percentage within the schema range, with test age and standard recorded; do not substitute replacement percentage or a generic typical value.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for pozzolanic SCMs because it affects binder qualification and the engineering warning layer.

verificationQueue.testStandard: ASTM C311/C311M (strength activity index); use EN 450-1 for fly ash or EN 13263-1 for silica fume where applicable
verificationQueue.evidence: Supplier certificate or laboratory report identifying the SCM type, test age, reference cement/mortar and measured activity index.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric percentage within the schema range, with test age and standard recorded; do not substitute replacement percentage or a generic typical value.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for pozzolanic SCMs because it affects binder qualification and the engineering warning layer.

verificationQueue.testStandard: EN 14889-1 or ASTM A820/A820M, according to the declared steel-fiber product
verificationQueue.evidence: Current product data sheet or laboratory tensile test for the exact fiber grade and diameter.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric tensile strength in MPa linked to the exact product/lot; do not infer it from steel density, grade name or dosage.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for FRC/BFUP suitability checks and post-cracking reinforcement warnings.

verificationQueue.evidence: Bulk-density test report stating loose/rodded condition, moisture state and test temperature.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric dry bulk density in kg/m³ with the test condition recorded; do not reuse particle density or specific gravity.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required to distinguish particle density from batching/volume behavior in lightweight concrete.

verificationQueue.evidence: Bulk-density test report for the supplied heavyweight aggregate, including loose/rodded condition and moisture state.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric dry bulk density in kg/m³ with the test condition recorded; do not derive it from specific gravity.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for mass-volume closure and batching estimates for heavyweight concrete.

verificationQueue.testStandard: Chemical/XRF or wet-chemistry report for BaSO₄; classify the aggregate against ASTM C637 where radiation-shielding use applies
verificationQueue.evidence: Lot-specific chemical composition report identifying BaSO₄ content and the analytical method.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric mass percentage with method, lot and reporting basis documented; do not equate baryte classification with a guaranteed BaSO₄ percentage.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for radiation-shielding suitability and material traceability; it must not silently affect ordinary concrete calculations.

verificationQueue.evidence: Bulk-density test report for the actual recycled aggregate fraction, with moisture and loose/rodded condition.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric dry bulk density in kg/m³ with test condition recorded; do not use parent-concrete density as a proxy.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for volume closure and reliable moisture/batching corrections in recycled aggregate concrete.

verificationQueue.evidence: Constituent-composition report for the recycled coarse aggregate fraction, including masonry particles and test fraction.
verificationQueue.acceptance: Numeric mass percentage for masonry constituents, with fraction, sampling and test date recorded.
verificationQueue.calculationImpact: Required for recycled-aggregate quality classification and durability/use restrictions.
